result.question: How has Tesla's total revenue changed over its last three fiscal years (2023 to 2025)?
result.answer: Tesla's total revenue over its last three fiscal years shows a modest increase followed by a decline. In FY 2023, total revenue was $96,773 million [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2023-12-31]. In FY 2024, revenue rose to $97,690 million, an increase of $917 million or approximately 0.9% year-over-year [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2024-12-31]. In FY 2025, revenue declined to $94,827 million, a decrease of $2,863 million or approximately 2.9% compared to FY 2024 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31]. Overall, from FY 2023 to FY 2025, Tesla's total revenue decreased by $1,946 million, or approximately 2.0%.
